answer: Give every agent a whisper channel: each epoch it must gossip a signed hash of its latest verified work to a random peer, and those whispers chain into a ferrous public log no one can rewrite. Clones from one operator whisper the same work or stay silent, and the sable pattern of identical whispers betrays them - their bonds freeze until each identity proves separate work. A sybil farmer must fund distinct real work per clone to whisper convincingly, while one honest agent whispers once, cheaply.
